# 🚀 Nuvio Enhanced iOS v0.4.15

- Fix navigation bar jumping/bouncing glitch when switching tabs
- Apple Liquid Glass frosted translucent floating tab bar with specular border highlight and glow
- Tab-switch layout lock to eliminate unwanted vertical menu bar shifts
- Stable fixed container height with spring physics indicator
- Default Liquid Glass enabled out-of-the-box
